meta.name: English
header.themeToggle: Switch between light and dark mode
header.note: A proxy checker for SOCKS5 / HTTP / HTTPS / TURN / SSTP built on Cloudflare Workers, with single or batch parsing, availability checks and exit information.
panel.title: Start checking
panel.copy: Enter a single proxy link, IP:port, domain:port, or a whole list. SOCKS5 / HTTP / HTTPS / TURN / SSTP are supported. If the protocol prefix is missing, socks5:// is used automatically.
input.label: Proxy link / domain proxy
input.placeholderBatch:
One proxy per line, for example:
socks5://user:pass@proxy.example.com:1080
http://1.1.1.1:8080
https://8.8.8.8:443
turn://test:test@167.172.34.1:3478
sstp://vpn:vpn@vpn986755484.opengw.net:1852
input.hintSingle: Single mode supports quick fill from history; press Enter to start checking.
input.hintBatch: In batch mode, enter one target per line; press Ctrl + Enter to start checking.
progress.label: Check progress
results.title: Results
results.metaInitial: Results, exit IPs and the map will appear here progressively as the checks proceed.
empty.title: Waiting to start
empty.description: After you enter targets, check results, exit information and the map will be shown here.
filter.empty: No results match the current filter.
theme.aria.dark: Dark mode is on. Click to switch to light mode.
theme.aria.light: Light mode is on. Click to switch to dark mode.
backend.tooltip: Connectivity is currently tested by the validation backend in the Cloudflare {colo} datacenter{location}. If the target is very far from this backend, it may be wrongly reported as unavailable because of high latency or timeouts; this does not necessarily mean it is unusable in your own environment.
detail.toggleAria: Expand or collapse details for exit IP {ip}
error.proxyScheme: Only socks5://, http://, https://, turn:// and sstp:// proxies are supported
error.invalidJson: The check API did not return valid JSON
summary.description.resolving: Received {count} inputs; expanding them into checkable addresses.
summary.meta.resolving: Resolving in progress; converting inputs into candidate targets.
summary.meta.done: This round is finished. Click an exit IP to copy it, or use the arrow beside it to see the exit location and network info.
summary.description.noTargets: Check the domain, IP or port format and try again.
summary.meta.noTargets: This input produced no valid candidate targets.
summary.headline.error: An error occurred during the check
summary.description.error: The request was interrupted or the remote API failed; please try again later.
summary.meta.error: The run was interrupted; results may be incomplete.
summary.meta.stopped: This round was stopped manually; tasks that had not started will not be requested.
empty.preparing.title: Preparing the check
empty.preparing.description: Resolving the targets you entered, please wait.
empty.noTargets.title: No checkable targets
empty.noTargets.description: Check the input format, or confirm the domain has A / AAAA records.
empty.error.title: Check process interrupted
empty.error.description: An error occurred during the request; please try again later.
export.none: No valid results to export under the current filter
export.txtEmpty: No TXT content to export under the current filter
export.clipboardFailed: Clipboard write failed; check browser permissions
export.failed: Export failed; please try again later
latency.tooltip: This latency is not from you to the proxy, but the check latency from {colo} to the proxy.
result.pendingDetail: Added to the check queue; waiting for the result.
result.successDetail: Proxy verified; you can view the exit location and network info.
result.failDetail: Cannot reach www.iplocate.io through this proxy; try another target.
result.stoppedDetail: Check stopped manually; no further requests were made for this proxy.
result.errorDetail: The check request failed; the API may have errored or the network was interrupted.
footer.builtOn: Built on and running on Cloudflare Workers
